Nun waghairah jaise Huroof-e-Hija ka mufassal bayaan Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein guzar chuka hai is liye yahan dohrane ki zaroorat nahi, kaha gaya hai ke yahan un se murad woh bari machli hai jo ek muheet-e-alam pani par hai jo saton zameeno ko uthaye hue hai, Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke sab se pehle Allah ne Qalam ko paida kiya aur us se farmaya likh us ne kaha kya likhun ? Farmaya taqdeer likh daal pas us din se lekar Qayamat tak jo kuch hone wala hai us par Qalam jari ho gaya phir Allah Ta'ala ne machli paida ki aur pani ke bukharat buland kiye, jis se aasman bane aur zameen ko us machli ki peeth par rakha machli ne harkat ki jis se zameen bhi hilne lagi pas zameen par pahar gaar kar use mazboot aur sakin kar diya, phir Aap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki (Ibn Abi Hatim) matlab yeh hai ke yahan "Nun" se murad yeh machli hai, Tabarani mein marfoo'an marwi hai ke sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Qalam ko aur machli ko paida kiya Qalam ne daryaft kiya main kya likhun ? Hukam hua har woh cheez jo Qayamat tak hone wali hai phir Aap ne pehli ayat ki tilawat ki, pas Nun se murad yeh machli hai aur Qalam se murad yeh Qalam hai, Ibn Asakir ki Hadees mein hai sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Qalam ko paida kiya phir Nun yani dawaat ko phir Qalam se farmaya likh us ne poocha kya ? Farmaya jo ho raha hai aur jo hone wala hai amal, rizq, umar, maut waghairah, pas Qalam ne sab kuch likh liya. Is ayat mein yehi murad hai, phir Qalam par mohar laga di ab woh Qayamat tak na chalega, phir Aql ko paida kiya aur farmaya mujhe apni izzat ki qsam apne doston mein toh main tujhe kamal tak pohnchaunga aur apne dushmanon mein tujhe naqis rakhunga, Mujahid farmate hain yeh mashhoor tha ke Nun se murad woh machli hai jo satween zameen ke neeche hai, Baghawi waghairah mufassireen farmate hain ke us machli ki peeth par ek chattan hai jis ki motai aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai us par ek bail hai jis ke chaalees hazaar seeng hain us ki peeth par saton zameenein aur un par tamam makhlooq hai, Wallahu Aalam aur taajjub toh yeh hai ke un ba'az mufassireen ne is Hadees ko bhi unhi maani par mahmool kiya hai jo Musnad Ahmad waghairah mein hai ke jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A ko khabar mili ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Madina aa gaye hain toh woh Aap ke paas aaye aur bohat kuch sawalat kiye kaha ke main woh batein poochhna chahta hoon jinhe nabiyon ke siva aur koi nahi janta bataiye Qayamat ki pehli nishani kya hai ? Aur jannatiyon ka pehla khana kya hai ? Aur kya wajah hai ke kabhi bacha apne baap ki soorat mein hota hai kabhi maan ki soorat par ? Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya yeh batein abhi abhi Jibreel ne mujhe bata di, Ibn Salam kehne lage farishton mein se yehi farishta hai jo yahudiyon ka dushman hai, Aap ne farmaya suno !

Qiyamat ki pehli nishani ek aag ka nikalna hai jo logon ko mashriq ki taraf se maghrib ki taraf le jayegi aur jannatiyon ka pehla khana machhli ki kaleji ki ziyadti hai aur mard ka pani aurat ke pani par sabiq aa jaye to larka hota hai aur jab aurat ka pani mard ke pani par subqat kar jaye to wohi khainch leti hai, dusri hadith mein itni ziyadti hai ki poocha jannatiyon ke is khane ke baad unhein kya milega farmaya jannati bail zabah kiya jayega jo jannat mein chorta chugta raha tha, poocha unhein pani konsa milega? farmaya Salsabil nami nahar ka, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki murad " Noon " se noor ki takhti hai ek mursal ghareeb hadith mein hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh ayat parh kar farmaya ki is se murad noor ki takhti aur noor ka hukum hai jo qiyamat tak ke haal par chal chuka hai, Ibn Juraij farmate hain mujhe khabar di gayi hai ki yeh noorani qalam sau saal ki tulani rakhta hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki " Noon " se murad daulat hai aur qalam se murad qalam hai, Hasan aur Qatadah bhi yehi farmate hain, ek bohat hi ghareeb marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh marwi hai jo Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Allah ne Noon ko paida kiya aur woh dawat hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain ki Allah Ta'ala ne Noon yani dawat ko paida kiya aur qalam ko paida kiya, phir farmaya " likh " us ne poocha " kya likhoon? " farmaya " likh " us ne poocha " kya likhoon? " jo qiyamat tak hone wala hai, aamal khwah naik hon khwah bad, rozi khwah halal ho khwah haram, phir yeh bhi ki konsi cheez duniya mein kab jayegi kis qadr rahegi, kaise niklegi, phir Allah Ta'ala ne bando par muhافظ rishte muqarrar kiye aur kitab par daroghe muqarrar kiye, muhافظ farishte har din un ke amal khazin farishton se daryaft kar ke likh lete hain jab rizq khatam ho jata hai umar poori ho jati hai ajal aa ponchti hai toh muhافظ farishte darogha farishton ke paas aa kar poochtay hain ki batao aaj ke din kya saman hai? woh kehte hain bas us shakhs ke liye hamare paas ab kuch bhi nahi raha yeh sun kar yeh farishte niche utarte hain toh dekhte hain ki woh mar gaya is bayan ke baad Hazrat Ibn Abbas ne farmaya tum to Arab ho kya tum ne Quran mein muhافظ farishton ki babat yeh nahi parha ayat (Inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum ta'maloon) (Al-Jathiyah: 29) matlab yeh hai ki hum tumhare aamal ko asl se naqal kar liya karte thay. Yeh to tha lafz " Noon " ke mutaliq bayan, ab qalam ki nisbat suniye. Bahar-haal murad yahan aam qalam hai jis se likha jata hai jaise aur jagah farman-e-aalishan hai ayat (Allazi 'allama bil-qalam) (Al-'Alaq: 4) yani us Allah ne qalam se likhna sikhaya, pas us ki qasam kha kar is baat par aagahi ki jati hai ki makhlooq par meri ek nemat yeh bhi hai ki maine unhein likhna sikhaya jis se uloom tak un ki rasai ho sake, is liye us ke baad farmaya ayat (Noon. Wal-qalami wa ma yasturoon) (Al-Qalam: 1).

(Al-Qalam: 1) Yaani us cheez ki qasam jo likhte hain, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se is ki tafseer yeh bhi marwi hai ke us cheez ki jo jaante hain, Suddi farmate hain murad is se farishton ka likhna hai jo bandoon ke amaal likhte hain aur mufassireen kehte hain is se murad woh qalam hai jo qudrati taur par chala aur taqdeerein likheen aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish se chaalees hazaar saal pehle aur is qaul ki daleel mein yeh jamaat woh hadeethein waarid karti hai jo qalam ke zikr mein marwi hain, Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke qalam se murad woh qalam hai jis se zikr likha gaya. Phir farmata hai ke aai Nabi tu bihamdillah deewana nahi jaise ke teri qaum ke jahil munkireen-e-haq kehte hain balkay tere liye ajr-e-azeem hai aur sawab be-payan hai jo na khatam ho na tute na kate kyunke tu ne haq-e-risalat ada kardiya hai aur hamari raah mein sakht se sakht museebatein jheeli hain hum tujhe behisaab badla denge, tu bahut bade khulq par hai yaani deen-e-Islam par aur behtareen adab par hai, Hazrat Aisha R.A se akhlaq-e-nabawi ke baare mein sawal hota hai to aap jawab deti hain ke aap ka khulq Quran tha, Saeed farmate hain yaani jaise ke Quran mein hai aur hadees mein hai ke Siddiqa R.A ne poocha ke kya tu ne Quran nahi padha, sail Hazrat Saeed bin Hisham ne kaha haan padha hai aap ne farmaya bas tu aap ka khulq Quran-e-Kareem tha, Muslim mein yeh hadees poori hai jise hum Surah Muzammil ki tafseer mein bayaan karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Banu Sawad ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Aisha R.A se yahi sawal kiya tha to aap ne yahi farha kar phir aayat (Wa innaka la'ala khuluqin azeem) 68. (Al-Qalam: 4) padhi us ne kaha koi ek aadh waqia to bayaan keejiye Umm-ul-Momineen R.A ne farmaya suno! Ek martaba maine bhi aap ke liye khana pakaya aur Hazrat Hafsa R.A ne bhi, maine apni laundi se kaha dekh agar mere khane se pehle Hazrat Hafsa R.A ke haan ka khana aajaye to tu bartan gira dena chunache us ne yahi kiya aur bartan bhi toot gaya, Huzoor ﷺ bikhre hue khane ko sametne lage aur farmaya is bartan ke badle sabit bartan tum do Wallah aur kuch danta dapta nahi (Musnad Ahmad). Matlab is hadees ka jo kayi turuq se mukhtalif alfaaz mein kayi kitabon mein hai yeh hai ke ek to aap ki jablat aur paidaish mein hi Allah ne pasandeeda akhlaq behtareen khaslatein aur pakeeza aadatein rakheen doosre aap ka amal Quran-e-Kareem par aisa tha ke goya ahkaam-e-Quran ka mujassam amli namoona hain, har hukum ko baja laane aur har nahi se ruk jaane mein aap ki halat yeh thi ke goya Quran mein jo kuch hai woh aap ki aadaton aur aap ke kareemana akhlaq ka bayaan hai. Hazrat Anas R.A ka bayaan hai ke maine Rasoolullah ﷺ ki das saal tak khidmat ki lekin kisi din aap ne mujhe 'uff' tak nahi kaha kisi karne ke kaam ko na karoon ya na karne ke kaam kar guzroon to bhi dant dapt to kuja itna bhi na farmate ke aisa kyun hua? Huzoor ﷺ sab se zyada khush khulq thay Huzoor ﷺ ki hatheli se zyada naram na to resham hai na koi aur cheez.

Huzoor ﷺ ke paseene se zyada khushbu wali cheez maine toh koi nahi soonghi na mushk aur na atr (Bukhari o Muslim). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Bara R.A farmate hain Rasool Allah ﷺ sab se zyada khubsurat aur sab se zyada khaliq thay, aap ka qad na toh bahut lamba tha na aap past qamat thay, is bare mein aur bhi bahut si hadeesein hain. Shamail-e-Tirmidhi mein Hazrat Aisha R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne hath se na toh kabhi kisi khadim ya ghulam ko mara na biwi bachon ko na kisi aur ko, haan Allah ki rah ka jihad alag cheez hai. Jab kabhi do kamon mein aap ko ikhtiyar diya jata toh aap use pasand karte jo zyada asan hota, haan yeh aur baat hai ke is mein kuch gunah ho toh aap us se bahut door ho jate. Kabhi bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne apna badla kisi se nahi liya, haan yeh aur baat hai ke koi Allah ki hurmaton ko todta ho toh aap Allah ke ahkam jari karne ke liye zaroor intiqam lete. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ irshad farmate hain: Main behtareen akhlaq aur pakeeza tareen aadaton ko poora karne ke liye aya hoon. 

Phir farmata hai ke اے نبی ﷺ (Aiy Nabi ﷺ) aap aur aap ke mukhalif aur munkir abhi abhi jaan lenge ke darasal behka hua aur gumrah kaun tha? Jaise aur jagah hai ayat: (Saya'lamoonal ghadam manil kadh-dhabul ashir - 54. (Al-Qamar: 26) Inhein abhi kal hi maloom ho jaye ga ke jhoota aur shikhi baaz kaun tha? Jaise aur jagah hai ayat: (Wa inna au iyyakum la 'ala hudan au fi dalalin mubeen - 34. (Saba': 24) Hum ya tum hidayat par hain ya ek khuli gumrahi par. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yaani yeh haqeeqat qayamat ke din khul jaye gi. Aap se marwi hai ke (maftoon) majnoon ko kehte hain, Mujahid waghera ka bhi yahi qoul hai. Qatadah waghera farmate hain yaani kaun shaitan se nazdeek tar hai? (Maftoon) ke zahiri maani yeh hain ke jo haq se behk jaye aur gumrah ho jaye. (Aiykum) par (ba) ko is liye dakhil kiya gaya hai ke dalalat ho jaye ke ayat: (Fasatubsiru wa yubsiroon - 68. (Al-Qalam: 5) mein tazmeen-e-fa'l hai, toh taqdeeri ibarat ko mila kar tarjuma yoon ho jaye ga ke tu bhi aur woh bhi anqareeb jaan lenge aur tu bhi aur woh sab bhi bahut jaldi maftoon ki khabar de denge, Wallahu A'lam. 

Phir farmaya ke tum mein se behakne wale aur rah-e-rast wale sab Allah par zahir hain, use khoob maloom hai ke rah-e-rast se kis ka qadam phisal gaya hai.)))

Nun waghairah jaise Huroof-e-Hija ka mufassal bayaan Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein guzar chuka hai is liye yahan dohrane ki zaroorat nahi, kaha gaya hai ke yahan un se murad woh bari machli hai jo ek muheet-e-alam pani par hai jo saton zameeno ko uthaye hue hai, Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke sab se pehle Allah ne Qalam ko paida kiya aur us se farmaya likh us ne kaha kya likhun ? Farmaya taqdeer likh daal pas us din se lekar Qayamat tak jo kuch hone wala hai us par Qalam jari ho gaya phir Allah Ta'ala ne machli paida ki aur pani ke bukharat buland kiye, jis se aasman bane aur zameen ko us machli ki peeth par rakha machli ne harkat ki jis se zameen bhi hilne lagi pas zameen par pahar gaar kar use mazboot aur sakin kar diya, phir Aap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki (Ibn Abi Hatim) matlab yeh hai ke yahan "Nun" se murad yeh machli hai, Tabarani mein marfoo'an marwi hai ke sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Qalam ko aur machli ko paida kiya Qalam ne daryaft kiya main kya likhun ? Hukam hua har woh cheez jo Qayamat tak hone wali hai phir Aap ne pehli ayat ki tilawat ki, pas Nun se murad yeh machli hai aur Qalam se murad yeh Qalam hai, Ibn Asakir ki Hadees mein hai sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Qalam ko paida kiya phir Nun yani dawaat ko phir Qalam se farmaya likh us ne poocha kya ? Farmaya jo ho raha hai aur jo hone wala hai amal, rizq, umar, maut waghairah, pas Qalam ne sab kuch likh liya. Is ayat mein yehi murad hai, phir Qalam par mohar laga di ab woh Qayamat tak na chalega, phir Aql ko paida kiya aur farmaya mujhe apni izzat ki qsam apne doston mein toh main tujhe kamal tak pohnchaunga aur apne dushmanon mein tujhe naqis rakhunga, Mujahid farmate hain yeh mashhoor tha ke Nun se murad woh machli hai jo satween zameen ke neeche hai, Baghawi waghairah mufassireen farmate hain ke us machli ki peeth par ek chattan hai jis ki motai aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai us par ek bail hai jis ke chaalees hazaar seeng hain us ki peeth par saton zameenein aur un par tamam makhlooq hai, Wallahu Aalam aur taajjub toh yeh hai ke un ba'az mufassireen ne is Hadees ko bhi unhi maani par mahmool kiya hai jo Musnad Ahmad waghairah mein hai ke jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A ko khabar mili ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Madina aa gaye hain toh woh Aap ke paas aaye aur bohat kuch sawalat kiye kaha ke main woh batein poochhna chahta hoon jinhe nabiyon ke siva aur koi nahi janta bataiye Qayamat ki pehli nishani kya hai ? Aur jannatiyon ka pehla khana kya hai ? Aur kya wajah hai ke kabhi bacha apne baap ki soorat mein hota hai kabhi maan ki soorat par ? Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya yeh batein abhi abhi Jibreel ne mujhe bata di, Ibn Salam kehne lage farishton mein se yehi farishta hai jo yahudiyon ka dushman hai, Aap ne farmaya suno !

Qiyamat ki pehli nishani ek aag ka nikalna hai jo logon ko mashriq ki taraf se maghrib ki taraf le jayegi aur jannatiyon ka pehla khana machhli ki kaleji ki ziyadti hai aur mard ka pani aurat ke pani par sabiq aa jaye to larka hota hai aur jab aurat ka pani mard ke pani par subqat kar jaye to wohi khainch leti hai, dusri hadith mein itni ziyadti hai ki poocha jannatiyon ke is khane ke baad unhein kya milega farmaya jannati bail zabah kiya jayega jo jannat mein chorta chugta raha tha, poocha unhein pani konsa milega? farmaya Salsabil nami nahar ka, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki murad " Noon " se noor ki takhti hai ek mursal ghareeb hadith mein hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh ayat parh kar farmaya ki is se murad noor ki takhti aur noor ka hukum hai jo qiyamat tak ke haal par chal chuka hai, Ibn Juraij farmate hain mujhe khabar di gayi hai ki yeh noorani qalam sau saal ki tulani rakhta hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki " Noon " se murad daulat hai aur qalam se murad qalam hai, Hasan aur Qatadah bhi yehi farmate hain, ek bohat hi ghareeb marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh marwi hai jo Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Allah ne Noon ko paida kiya aur woh dawat hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain ki Allah Ta'ala ne Noon yani dawat ko paida kiya aur qalam ko paida kiya, phir farmaya " likh " us ne poocha " kya likhoon? " farmaya " likh " us ne poocha " kya likhoon? " jo qiyamat tak hone wala hai, aamal khwah naik hon khwah bad, rozi khwah halal ho khwah haram, phir yeh bhi ki konsi cheez duniya mein kab jayegi kis qadr rahegi, kaise niklegi, phir Allah Ta'ala ne bando par muhافظ rishte muqarrar kiye aur kitab par daroghe muqarrar kiye, muhافظ farishte har din un ke amal khazin farishton se daryaft kar ke likh lete hain jab rizq khatam ho jata hai umar poori ho jati hai ajal aa ponchti hai toh muhافظ farishte darogha farishton ke paas aa kar poochtay hain ki batao aaj ke din kya saman hai? woh kehte hain bas us shakhs ke liye hamare paas ab kuch bhi nahi raha yeh sun kar yeh farishte niche utarte hain toh dekhte hain ki woh mar gaya is bayan ke baad Hazrat Ibn Abbas ne farmaya tum to Arab ho kya tum ne Quran mein muhافظ farishton ki babat yeh nahi parha ayat (Inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum ta'maloon) (Al-Jathiyah: 29) matlab yeh hai ki hum tumhare aamal ko asl se naqal kar liya karte thay. Yeh to tha lafz " Noon " ke mutaliq bayan, ab qalam ki nisbat suniye. Bahar-haal murad yahan aam qalam hai jis se likha jata hai jaise aur jagah farman-e-aalishan hai ayat (Allazi 'allama bil-qalam) (Al-'Alaq: 4) yani us Allah ne qalam se likhna sikhaya, pas us ki qasam kha kar is baat par aagahi ki jati hai ki makhlooq par meri ek nemat yeh bhi hai ki maine unhein likhna sikhaya jis se uloom tak un ki rasai ho sake, is liye us ke baad farmaya ayat (Noon. Wal-qalami wa ma yasturoon) (Al-Qalam: 1).

Hazrat Anas R.A ka bayaan hai ke maine Rasoolullah ﷺ ki das saal tak khidmat ki lekin kisi din aap ne mujhe 'uff' tak nahi kaha kisi karne ke kaam ko na karoon ya na karne ke kaam kar guzroon to bhi dant dapt to kuja itna bhi na farmate ke aisa kyun hua? Huzoor ﷺ sab se zyada khush khulq thay Huzoor ﷺ ki hatheli se zyada naram na to resham hai na koi aur cheez.

Nun waghairah jaise Huroof-e-Hija ka mufassal bayaan Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein guzar chuka hai is liye yahan dohrane ki zaroorat nahi, kaha gaya hai ke yahan un se murad woh bari machli hai jo ek muheet-e-alam pani par hai jo saton zameeno ko uthaye hue hai, Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke sab se pehle Allah ne Qalam ko paida kiya aur us se farmaya likh us ne kaha kya likhun ? Farmaya taqdeer likh daal pas us din se lekar Qayamat tak jo kuch hone wala hai us par Qalam jari ho gaya phir Allah Ta'ala ne machli paida ki aur pani ke bukharat buland kiye, jis se aasman bane aur zameen ko us machli ki peeth par rakha machli ne harkat ki jis se zameen bhi hilne lagi pas zameen par pahar gaar kar use mazboot aur sakin kar diya, phir Aap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki (Ibn Abi Hatim) matlab yeh hai ke yahan "Nun" se murad yeh machli hai, Tabarani mein marfoo'an marwi hai ke sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Qalam ko aur machli ko paida kiya Qalam ne daryaft kiya main kya likhun ? Hukam hua har woh cheez jo Qayamat tak hone wali hai phir Aap ne pehli ayat ki tilawat ki, pas Nun se murad yeh machli hai aur Qalam se murad yeh Qalam hai, Ibn Asakir ki Hadees mein hai sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Qalam ko paida kiya phir Nun yani dawaat ko phir Qalam se farmaya likh us ne poocha kya ? Farmaya jo ho raha hai aur jo hone wala hai amal, rizq, umar, maut waghairah, pas Qalam ne sab kuch likh liya. Is ayat mein yehi murad hai, phir Qalam par mohar laga di ab woh Qayamat tak na chalega, phir Aql ko paida kiya aur farmaya mujhe apni izzat ki qsam apne doston mein toh main tujhe kamal tak pohnchaunga aur apne dushmanon mein tujhe naqis rakhunga, Mujahid farmate hain yeh mashhoor tha ke Nun se murad woh machli hai jo satween zameen ke neeche hai, Baghawi waghairah mufassireen farmate hain ke us machli ki peeth par ek chattan hai jis ki motai aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai us par ek bail hai jis ke chaalees hazaar seeng hain us ki peeth par saton zameenein aur un par tamam makhlooq hai, Wallahu Aalam aur taajjub toh yeh hai ke un ba'az mufassireen ne is Hadees ko bhi unhi maani par mahmool kiya hai jo Musnad Ahmad waghairah mein hai ke jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A ko khabar mili ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Madina aa gaye hain toh woh Aap ke paas aaye aur bohat kuch sawalat kiye kaha ke main woh batein poochhna chahta hoon jinhe nabiyon ke siva aur koi nahi janta bataiye Qayamat ki pehli nishani kya hai ? (Al-Qalam: 1) Yaani us cheez ki qasam jo likhte hain, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se is ki tafseer yeh bhi marwi hai ke us cheez ki jo jaante hain, Suddi farmate hain murad is se farishton ka likhna hai jo bandoon ke amaal likhte hain aur mufassireen kehte hain is se murad woh qalam hai jo qudrati taur par chala aur taqdeerein likheen aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish se chaalees hazaar saal pehle aur is qaul ki daleel mein yeh jamaat woh hadeethein waarid karti hai jo qalam ke zikr mein marwi hain, Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke qalam se murad woh qalam hai jis se zikr likha gaya. Phir farmata hai ke aai Nabi tu bihamdillah deewana nahi jaise ke teri qaum ke jahil munkireen-e-haq kehte hain balkay tere liye ajr-e-azeem hai aur sawab be-payan hai jo na khatam ho na tute na kate kyunke tu ne haq-e-risalat ada kardiya hai aur hamari raah mein sakht se sakht museebatein jheeli hain hum tujhe behisaab badla denge, tu bahut bade khulq par hai yaani deen-e-Islam par aur behtareen adab par hai, Hazrat Aisha R.A se akhlaq-e-nabawi ke baare mein sawal hota hai to aap jawab deti hain ke aap ka khulq Quran tha, Saeed farmate hain yaani jaise ke Quran mein hai aur hadees mein hai ke Siddiqa R.A ne poocha ke kya tu ne Quran nahi padha, sail Hazrat Saeed bin Hisham ne kaha haan padha hai aap ne farmaya bas tu aap ka khulq Quran-e-Kareem tha, Muslim mein yeh hadees poori hai jise hum Surah Muzammil ki tafseer mein bayaan karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Banu Sawad ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Aisha R.A se yahi sawal kiya tha to aap ne yahi farha kar phir aayat (Wa innaka la'ala khuluqin azeem) 68. (Al-Qalam: 4) padhi us ne kaha koi ek aadh waqia to bayaan keejiye Umm-ul-Momineen R.A ne farmaya suno! Ek martaba maine bhi aap ke liye khana pakaya aur Hazrat Hafsa R.A ne bhi, maine apni laundi se kaha dekh agar mere khane se pehle Hazrat Hafsa R.A ke haan ka khana aajaye to tu bartan gira dena chunache us ne yahi kiya aur bartan bhi toot gaya, Huzoor ﷺ bikhre hue khane ko sametne lage aur farmaya is bartan ke badle sabit bartan tum do Wallah aur kuch danta dapta nahi (Musnad Ahmad). Matlab is hadees ka jo kayi turuq se mukhtalif alfaaz mein kayi kitabon mein hai yeh hai ke ek to aap ki jablat aur paidaish mein hi Allah ne pasandeeda akhlaq behtareen khaslatein aur pakeeza aadatein rakheen doosre aap ka amal Quran-e-Kareem par aisa tha ke goya ahkaam-e-Quran ka mujassam amli namoona hain, har hukum ko baja laane aur har nahi se ruk jaane mein aap ki halat yeh thi ke goya Quran mein jo kuch hai woh aap ki aadaton aur aap ke kareemana akhlaq ka bayaan hai. Hazrat Anas R.A ka bayaan hai ke maine Rasoolullah ﷺ ki das saal tak khidmat ki lekin kisi din aap ne mujhe 'uff' tak nahi kaha kisi karne ke kaam ko na karoon ya na karne ke kaam kar guzroon to bhi dant dapt to kuja itna bhi na farmate ke aisa kyun hua? Huzoor ﷺ sab se zyada khush khulq thay Huzoor ﷺ ki hatheli se zyada naram na to resham hai na koi aur cheez.

Huzoor ﷺ ke paseene se zyada khushbu wali cheez maine toh koi nahi soonghi na mushk aur na atr (Bukhari o Muslim). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Bara R.A farmate hain Rasool Allah ﷺ sab se zyada khubsurat aur sab se zyada khaliq thay, aap ka qad na toh bahut lamba tha na aap past qamat thay, is bare mein aur bhi bahut si hadeesein hain. Shamail-e-Tirmidhi mein Hazrat Aisha R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne hath se na toh kabhi kisi khadim ya ghulam ko mara na biwi bachon ko na kisi aur ko, haan Allah ki rah ka jihad alag cheez hai. Jab kabhi do kamon mein aap ko ikhtiyar diya jata toh aap use pasand karte jo zyada asan hota, haan yeh aur baat hai ke is mein kuch gunah ho toh aap us se bahut door ho jate. Kabhi bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne apna badla kisi se nahi liya, haan yeh aur baat hai ke koi Allah ki hurmaton ko todta ho toh aap Allah ke ahkam jari karne ke liye zaroor intiqam lete. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ irshad farmate hain: Main behtareen akhlaq aur pakeeza tareen aadaton ko poora karne ke liye aya hoon. 

Phir farmata hai ke اے نبی ﷺ (Aiy Nabi ﷺ) aap aur aap ke mukhalif aur munkir abhi abhi jaan lenge ke darasal behka hua aur gumrah kaun tha? Jaise aur jagah hai ayat: (Saya'lamoonal ghadam manil kadh-dhabul ashir - 54. (Al-Qamar: 26) Inhein abhi kal hi maloom ho jaye ga ke jhoota aur shikhi baaz kaun tha? Jaise aur jagah hai ayat: (Wa inna au iyyakum la 'ala hudan au fi dalalin mubeen - 34. (Saba': 24) Hum ya tum hidayat par hain ya ek khuli gumrahi par. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yaani yeh haqeeqat qayamat ke din khul jaye gi. Aap se marwi hai ke (maftoon) majnoon ko kehte hain, Mujahid waghera ka bhi yahi qoul hai. Qatadah waghera farmate hain yaani kaun shaitan se nazdeek tar hai? (Maftoon) ke zahiri maani yeh hain ke jo haq se behk jaye aur gumrah ho jaye. (Aiykum) par (ba) ko is liye dakhil kiya gaya hai ke dalalat ho jaye ke ayat: (Fasatubsiru wa yubsiroon - 68. (Al-Qalam: 5) mein tazmeen-e-fa'l hai, toh taqdeeri ibarat ko mila kar tarjuma yoon ho jaye ga ke tu bhi aur woh bhi anqareeb jaan lenge aur tu bhi aur woh sab bhi bahut jaldi maftoon ki khabar de denge, Wallahu A'lam. 

Phir farmaya ke tum mein se behakne wale aur rah-e-rast wale sab Allah par zahir hain, use khoob maloom hai ke rah-e-rast se kis ka qadam phisal gaya hai.)))

Nun waghairah jaise Huroof-e-Hija ka mufassal bayaan Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein guzar chuka hai is liye yahan dohrane ki zaroorat nahi, kaha gaya hai ke yahan un se murad woh bari machli hai jo ek muheet-e-alam pani par hai jo saton zameeno ko uthaye hue hai, Ibn Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke sab se pehle Allah ne Qalam ko paida kiya aur us se farmaya likh us ne kaha kya likhun ? Farmaya taqdeer likh daal pas us din se lekar Qayamat tak jo kuch hone wala hai us par Qalam jari ho gaya phir Allah Ta'ala ne machli paida ki aur pani ke bukharat buland kiye, jis se aasman bane aur zameen ko us machli ki peeth par rakha machli ne harkat ki jis se zameen bhi hilne lagi pas zameen par pahar gaar kar use mazboot aur sakin kar diya, phir Aap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki (Ibn Abi Hatim) matlab yeh hai ke yahan "Nun" se murad yeh machli hai, Tabarani mein marfoo'an marwi hai ke sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Qalam ko aur machli ko paida kiya Qalam ne daryaft kiya main kya likhun ? Hukam hua har woh cheez jo Qayamat tak hone wali hai phir Aap ne pehli ayat ki tilawat ki, pas Nun se murad yeh machli hai aur Qalam se murad yeh Qalam hai, Ibn Asakir ki Hadees mein hai sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne Qalam ko paida kiya phir Nun yani dawaat ko phir Qalam se farmaya likh us ne poocha kya ? Farmaya jo ho raha hai aur jo hone wala hai amal, rizq, umar, maut waghairah, pas Qalam ne sab kuch likh liya. Is ayat mein yehi murad hai, phir Qalam par mohar laga di ab woh Qayamat tak na chalega, phir Aql ko paida kiya aur farmaya mujhe apni izzat ki qsam apne doston mein toh main tujhe kamal tak pohnchaunga aur apne dushmanon mein tujhe naqis rakhunga, Mujahid farmate hain yeh mashhoor tha ke Nun se murad woh machli hai jo satween zameen ke neeche hai, Baghawi waghairah mufassireen farmate hain ke us machli ki peeth par ek chattan hai jis ki motai aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai us par ek bail hai jis ke chaalees hazaar seeng hain us ki peeth par saton zameenein aur un par tamam makhlooq hai, Wallahu Aalam aur taajjub toh yeh hai ke un ba'az mufassireen ne is Hadees ko bhi unhi maani par mahmool kiya hai jo Musnad Ahmad waghairah mein hai ke jab Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A ko khabar mili ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Madina aa gaye hain toh woh Aap ke paas aaye aur bohat kuch sawalat kiye kaha ke main woh batein poochhna chahta hoon jinhe nabiyon ke siva aur koi nahi janta bataiye Qayamat ki pehli nishani kya hai ? Aur jannatiyon ka pehla khana kya hai ? Aur kya wajah hai ke kabhi bacha apne baap ki soorat mein hota hai kabhi maan ki soorat par ? Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya yeh batein abhi abhi Jibreel ne mujhe bata di, Ibn Salam kehne lage farishton mein se yehi farishta hai jo yahudiyon ka dushman hai, Aap ne farmaya suno !

Qiyamat ki pehli nishani ek aag ka nikalna hai jo logon ko mashriq ki taraf se maghrib ki taraf le jayegi aur jannatiyon ka pehla khana machhli ki kaleji ki ziyadti hai aur mard ka pani aurat ke pani par sabiq aa jaye to larka hota hai aur jab aurat ka pani mard ke pani par subqat kar jaye to wohi khainch leti hai, dusri hadith mein itni ziyadti hai ki poocha jannatiyon ke is khane ke baad unhein kya milega farmaya jannati bail zabah kiya jayega jo jannat mein chorta chugta raha tha, poocha unhein pani konsa milega? farmaya Salsabil nami nahar ka, yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki murad " Noon " se noor ki takhti hai ek mursal ghareeb hadith mein hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh ayat parh kar farmaya ki is se murad noor ki takhti aur noor ka hukum hai jo qiyamat tak ke haal par chal chuka hai, Ibn Juraij farmate hain mujhe khabar di gayi hai ki yeh noorani qalam sau saal ki tulani rakhta hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki " Noon " se murad daulat hai aur qalam se murad qalam hai, Hasan aur Qatadah bhi yehi farmate hain, ek bohat hi ghareeb marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh marwi hai jo Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Allah ne Noon ko paida kiya aur woh dawat hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain ki Allah Ta'ala ne Noon yani dawat ko paida kiya aur qalam ko paida kiya, phir farmaya " likh " us ne poocha " kya likhoon? " farmaya " likh " us ne poocha " kya likhoon? " jo qiyamat tak hone wala hai, aamal khwah naik hon khwah bad, rozi khwah halal ho khwah haram, phir yeh bhi ki konsi cheez duniya mein kab jayegi kis qadr rahegi, kaise niklegi, phir Allah Ta'ala ne bando par muhافظ rishte muqarrar kiye aur kitab par daroghe muqarrar kiye, muhافظ farishte har din un ke amal khazin farishton se daryaft kar ke likh lete hain jab rizq khatam ho jata hai umar poori ho jati hai ajal aa ponchti hai toh muhافظ farishte darogha farishton ke paas aa kar poochtay hain ki batao aaj ke din kya saman hai? woh kehte hain bas us shakhs ke liye hamare paas ab kuch bhi nahi raha yeh sun kar yeh farishte niche utarte hain toh dekhte hain ki woh mar gaya is bayan ke baad Hazrat Ibn Abbas ne farmaya tum to Arab ho kya tum ne Quran mein muhافظ farishton ki babat yeh nahi parha ayat (Inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum ta'maloon) (Al-Jathiyah: 29) matlab yeh hai ki hum tumhare aamal ko asl se naqal kar liya karte thay. Yeh to tha lafz " Noon " ke mutaliq bayan, ab qalam ki nisbat suniye. Ziyada qasmein khane wale ziyada jhoot boltay hain. Allah Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke Aye Nabi ﷺ jo naamatein hum ne tujhe dien, jo Sirat-e-Mustaqeem aur Khulq-e-Azeem hum ne tujhe ata farmaya, ab tujhe chahiye ke hamari na mannay walon ki tu na man, un ki tu ain khushi hai ke aap zara bhi narm parein toh yeh khul khelein aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke yeh chahte hain ke aap un ke ma'boodan-e-batil ki taraf kuch toh rukh karein, haq se zara sa toh idhar udhar ho jayein. Phir farmata hai ke ziyada qasmein khane wale kameenay shakhs ki bhi na man, chunke jhoote shakhs ko apni zillat aur kizb-e-bayani ke zahir ho jane ka dar rehta hai, is liye woh qasmein kha kha kar doosre ko apna yaqeen dilana chahta hai, lagataar qasmon par qasmein khaye chala jata hai aur Allah ke namon ko be-moqa istemal karta phirta hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmaate hain (Muhain) se murad kazib hai. Mujahid kehte hain zaeef dil wala. Hasan kehte hain (Hallaf) mukabira karne wala aur (Muhain) zaeef, (Hummaz) gheebat karne wala, chughal khor jo idhar ki udhar lagaye aur idhar ki udhar taake fasad ho jaye, tabiyaton mein nafrat aur dilon mein dushmani aa jaye. Rasool Allah ﷺ ke raste mein do qabrein aa gayin, aap ne farmaya: In dono ko azab ho raha hai aur kisi baray amr par nahi, ek toh peshab karne mein pardey ka khayal na rakhta tha, doosra chughal khor tha (Bukhari wa Muslim). Farmata hai: Chughal khor jannat mein na jaye ga (Musnad). Doosri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Huzaifa ne yeh hadis us waqt sunayi thi jab aap se kaha gaya ke yeh shakhs khufiya police ka aadmi hai. Musnad Ahmad ki hadis mein hai, Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Kya main tumhein na bataun ke tum mein sab se bhala shakhs kaun hai? Logon ne kaha: Zaroor irshad farmaiye. Farmaya: Woh ke

Farmaya bad-khlaq, khoob khane pine wala, logon par zulm karne wala, petu aadmi. Lekin is riwayat ko aksar raviyon ne mursal bayan kiya hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai: Is nalaiq shakhs par aasman rota hai jise Allah ne tandurusti di, pet bhar khane ko diya, maal-o-jah bhi ata farmayi, phir bhi logon par zulm-o-sitam kar raha hai. Yeh hadith bhi do mursal tariqon se marwi hai. Gharaz (Utul) kehte hain jiske badan sahih ho, taqatwar ho aur khoob khane pine wala zor-dar shakhs ho. 

(Zanim) se murad badnam hai jo burai mein mashhoor ho. Lughat-e-Arab mein (Zanim) use kehte hain jo kisi qaum mein samjha jata ho lekin darasal us ka na ho. Arab shaaron ne ise isi mani mein bandha hai yaani jiska nasab sahih na ho. Kaha gaya hai ki murad is se Akhnas bin Shariq Thaqafi hai jo Bani Zuhra ka halif tha aur baaz kehte hain yeh Aswad bin Abd Yaghus Zuhri hai. Ikramah farmate hain walad-uz-zina murad hai. Yeh bhi bayan hua hai ki jis tarah ek bakri jo tamam bakriyon mein se alag thalag apna chara hua kaan apni gardan par latkaye hue ho toh yeh yak-nigah pehchan li jati hai, usi tarah kafir mominon mein pehchan liya jata hai. Isi tarah ke aur bhi bohat se aqwal hain lekin khulasa sab ka sirf isi qadr hai ki Zanim woh shakhs hai jo burai se mashhoor ho aur umuman aise log idhar udhar se mile hue hote hain jinke sahih nasab ka aur haqiqi baap ka pata nahi hota, aison par shaitan ka ghalba bohat zyada raha karta hai, jaise hadith mein hai: Zana ki aulad jannat mein nahi jayegi. Aur riwayat mein hai ki zana ki aulad teen bure logon ki burai ka majmua hai, agar woh bhi apne maa baap ke se kaam kare. 

Phir farmaya is ki in shararton ki wajah yeh hai ki yeh maldar aur beton ka baap ban gaya hai. Hamari is nemat ka gun gana toh kahan, hamari aayton ko jhutlata hai aur tauheen kar ke kehta phirti hai ki yeh toh purane afsane hain. Farmaya bad-khlaq, khoob khane pine wala, logon par zulm karne wala, petu aadmi. Lekin is riwayat ko aksar raviyon ne mursal bayan kiya hai. (Zanim) se murad badnam hai jo burai mein mashhoor ho. Lughat-e-Arab mein (Zanim) use kehte hain jo kisi qaum mein samjha jata ho lekin darasal us ka na ho. Arab shaaron ne ise isi mani mein bandha hai yaani jiska nasab sahih na ho. Kaha gaya hai ki murad is se Akhnas bin Shariq Thaqafi hai jo Bani Zuhra ka halif tha aur baaz kehte hain yeh Aswad bin Abd Yaghus Zuhri hai. Ikramah farmate hain walad-uz-zina murad hai. Yeh bhi bayan hua hai ki jis tarah ek bakri jo tamam bakriyon mein se alag thalag apna chara hua kaan apni gardan par latkaye hue ho toh yeh yak-nigah pehchan li jati hai, usi tarah kafir mominon mein pehchan liya jata hai. Isi tarah ke aur bhi bohat se aqwal hain lekin khulasa sab ka sirf isi qadr hai ki Zanim woh shakhs hai jo burai se mashhoor ho aur umuman aise log idhar udhar se mile hue hote hain jinke sahih nasab ka aur haqiqi baap ka pata nahi hota, aison par shaitan ka ghalba bohat zyada raha karta hai, jaise hadith mein hai: Zana ki aulad jannat mein nahi jayegi. Aur riwayat mein hai ki zana ki aulad teen bure logon ki burai ka majmua hai, agar woh bhi apne maa baap ke se kaam kare. 

Phir farmaya is ki in shararton ki wajah yeh hai ki yeh maldar aur beton ka baap ban gaya hai. (Zanim) se murad badnam hai jo burai mein mashhoor ho. Lughat-e-Arab mein (Zanim) use kehte hain jo kisi qaum mein samjha jata ho lekin darasal us ka na ho. Arab shaaron ne ise isi mani mein bandha hai yaani jiska nasab sahih na ho. Kaha gaya hai ki murad is se Akhnas bin Shariq Thaqafi hai jo Bani Zuhra ka halif tha aur baaz kehte hain yeh Aswad bin Abd Yaghus Zuhri hai. Ikramah farmate hain walad-uz-zina murad hai. Yeh bhi bayan hua hai ki jis tarah ek bakri jo tamam bakriyon mein se alag thalag apna chara hua kaan apni gardan par latkaye hue ho toh yeh yak-nigah pehchan li jati hai, usi tarah kafir mominon mein pehchan liya jata hai. Isi tarah ke aur bhi bohat se aqwal hain lekin khulasa sab ka sirf isi qadr hai ki Zanim woh shakhs hai jo burai se mashhoor ho aur umuman aise log idhar udhar se mile hue hote hain jinke sahih nasab ka aur haqiqi baap ka pata nahi hota, aison par shaitan ka ghalba bohat zyada raha karta hai, jaise hadith mein hai: Zana ki aulad jannat mein nahi jayegi. Aur riwayat mein hai ki zana ki aulad teen bure logon ki burai ka majmua hai, agar woh bhi apne maa baap ke se kaam kare. 

Phir farmaya is ki in shararton ki wajah yeh hai ki yeh maldar aur beton ka baap ban gaya hai. Hamari is nemat ka gun gana toh kahan, hamari aayton ko jhutlata hai aur tauheen kar ke kehta phirti hai ki yeh toh purane afsane hain. Aur jagah Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai aayat: (Zarnee wa man khalaqtu waheeda) (Al-Muddaththir: 11) "Mujhe chor de aur use jise maine yakta paida kiya hai aur bohat sa maal diya hai aur hazir-bash larke diye hain aur bhi bohat kushaadgi de rakhi hai phir bhi is ki tama hai ki main use aur doon, hargiz aisa nahi ho sakta, yeh toh meri aayton ka mukhalif hai, main ise anqareeb badtareen museebat mein dalunga, is ne ghor-o-fikr ke andaza lagaya yeh tabah ho."

Kitni buri tajweez us ne sochi, main phir kehta hoon, yeh barbad ho us ne kaisi buri tajweez ki! Us ne phir nazar dali aur tursh-ro ho ke munh bana liya, phir munh pher kar ainthne laga aur keh diya ke yeh Kalamullah toh purana naqal kiya hua jadoo hai, saaf zahir hai ke yeh insani kalam hai. Us ki is baat par main bhi ise (Saqar) mein daalon ga, tujhe kya maloom ke (Saqar) kya hai? Na woh baaqi rakhe na chore, badan par lapet jati hai, us par untees farishte mutaeen hain. 

Isi tarah yahan bhi farmaya ke us ki naak par hum daagh lagayenge, yaani ise hum is qadr ruswa karenge ke us ki burai kisi par poshida na rahe, har ek ise jaan-pehchan le, jaise nishandaar naak wale ko ek nigaah mein hazaron mein log pehchan lete hain aur jo daagh chhupaye na chhup sake. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Badar wale din us ki naak par talwar lagegi aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Qiyamat wale din Jahannam ki mohar lagegi, yaani munh kala kar diya jayega toh naak se murad poora chehra huwa. 

Imam Abu Jafar Ibn Jareer ne in tamam aqwal ko waarad kar ke farmaya hai ke in sab mein tatbeeq is tarah ho jati hai ke yeh kul umoor is mein jama ho jayein, yeh bhi ho woh bhi ho; duniya mein ruswa ho, sach-much naak par nishaan lage, aakhirat mein bhi nishandaar mujrim bane. Fi al-waqt yeh bahut durust hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein farman-e-Rasool ﷺ hai ke banda hazarha baras tak Allah ke yahan momin likha rehta hai lekin marta is halat mein hai ke Allah us par naraz hota hai, aur banda Allah ke haan kafir hazarha saal tak likha rehta hai phir marte waqt Allah us se khush ho jata hai. Jo shakhs aib-goi aur chughal-khori ki halat mein mare, jo logon ko badnaam karne wala ho, Qiyamat ke din us ki naak par dono honton ki taraf se nishaan laga diya jaye jo us mujrim ki alamat ban jaye.

Ziyada qasmein khane wale ziyada jhoot boltay hain. Allah Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke Aye Nabi ﷺ jo naamatein hum ne tujhe dien, jo Sirat-e-Mustaqeem aur Khulq-e-Azeem hum ne tujhe ata farmaya, ab tujhe chahiye ke hamari na mannay walon ki tu na man, un ki tu ain khushi hai ke aap zara bhi narm parein toh yeh khul khelein aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke yeh chahte hain ke aap un ke ma'boodan-e-batil ki taraf kuch toh rukh karein, haq se zara sa toh idhar udhar ho jayein. Phir farmata hai ke ziyada qasmein khane wale kameenay shakhs ki bhi na man, chunke jhoote shakhs ko apni zillat aur kizb-e-bayani ke zahir ho jane ka dar rehta hai, is liye woh qasmein kha kha kar doosre ko apna yaqeen dilana chahta hai, lagataar qasmon par qasmein khaye chala jata hai aur Allah ke namon ko be-moqa istemal karta phirta hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmaate hain (Muhain) se murad kazib hai. Mujahid kehte hain zaeef dil wala. Hasan kehte hain (Hallaf) mukabira karne wala aur (Muhain) zaeef, (Hummaz) gheebat karne wala, chughal khor jo idhar ki udhar lagaye aur idhar ki udhar taake fasad ho jaye, tabiyaton mein nafrat aur dilon mein dushmani aa jaye. Rasool Allah ﷺ ke raste mein do qabrein aa gayin, aap ne farmaya: In dono ko azab ho raha hai aur kisi baray amr par nahi, ek toh peshab karne mein pardey ka khayal na rakhta tha, doosra chughal khor tha (Bukhari wa Muslim). Yeh jaante the ke ab hum phalon par qabiz hain abhi utaar kar sab le aayenge, lekin jab wahan pahuche toh haka baka reh gaye.

Ke lehlahata huwa hara bhara bagh mewon se lade hue darakht aur pake hue phal sab gharat aur barbad hochuke hain, sare bagh mein aandhi phir gayi hai aur kul bagh mewon samet jal kar koyla hogaya hai, koi phal nisf dam ka bhi nahi raha, sari tarotazagi پژمردگی (pazmurdagi) se badal gayi hai, bagh sara ka sara jal kar rakh hogaya hai, darakhton ke kale kale daraune tund khade hue hain, pehle to samjhe ke hum rah bhool gaye kisi aur bagh mein chale aaye aur yeh matlab bhi hosakta hai ke hamara tareeqa-e-kar ghalat tha jiska yeh nateeja hai, phir baghaur dekhne se jab yaqeen hogaya ke bagh to yeh hamara hi hai tab samajh gaye aur kehne lage hai to yehi lekin hum badqismat hain, hamare naseeb mein hi iska phal aur faida nahi, in sab mein jo adl-o-insaf wala aur bhalai aur behtari wala tha woh bol pada ke dekho main to pehle hi tumse kehta tha ke tum Insha'Allah kyun nahi kehte, Sadi farmate hain unke zamanah mein SubhanAllah kehna bhi Insha'Allah kehne ke qaim maqam tha, Imam Ibn Jareer farmate hain iske maani hi Insha'Allah kehne ke hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke unke behtar shakhs ne unse kaha ke dekho maine to tumhe pehle hi keh diya tha ke tum kyun Allah ki pakeezgi aur uski hamd-o-sana nahi karte? Yeh sun kar ab woh kehne lage hamara Rab pak hai beshak hum ne apni janon par zulm kiya, ab itaat baja laye jabke azab pahunch chuka, ab apni taqseer ko mana jab saza de di gayi, ab to ek dusre ko malamat karne lage ke hum ne bahut hi bura kiya ke maskinon ka haq marna chaha aur Allah ki farmanbardari se ruk gaye, phir sab ne kaha ke koi shak nahi hamari sarkashi had se badh gayi isi wajah se Allah ka azab aaya, phir kehte hain shayad hamara Rab humein isse behtar badla de yani duniya mein aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke akhirat ke khayal se unhone yeh kaha ho, Wallahu A'lam, baaz salaf ka qaul hai ke yeh waqia Ahl-e-Yaman ka hai, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain yeh log Frawan ke rehne wale the jo Sana se chhe mil ke fasla par ek basti hai aur mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh Ahl-e-Habsha thay.

Mazhaban Ahl-e-Kitab thay, yeh bagh unhein un ke baap ke warse mein mila tha. Is ka yeh dastoor tha ke bagh ki paidawar mein se bagh ka kharch nikaal kar apne aur apne baal bachon ke liye saal bhar ka kharch rakh kar baaqi nafa Allah ke naam sadqa kar deta tha. Us ke inteqaal ke baad un bachon ne aapas mein mashwra kiya aur kaha ke hamara baap to bewuqoof tha jo itni badi rakam har saal idhar udhar de deta tha, hum in faqiron ko agar na dein aur apna maal baqaida sanbhaal_ein to bohat jald daulatmand ban jayenge. Yeh irada unhon ne pukhta kar liya to un par woh azab aaya jis ne asl maal bhi tabaah kar diya aur bilkul khaali haath reh gaye. Phir farmata hai jo shakhs bhi Allah ke hukmon ke khilaf kare aur Allah ki nematon mein bakhal kare aur maskinon mohtajon ka haq ada na kare aur Allah ki nemat ki nashukri kare, us par usi tarah ke azab nazil hote hain aur yeh to duniyawi azab hain, aakhirat ke azab to abhi baaqi hain jo sakht tar aur badtar hain. Baihaqi ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne raat ke waqt kheti kaatne aur bagh ke phal utaarne se mana farma diya hai.

Yeh jaante the ke ab hum phalon par qabiz hain abhi utaar kar sab le aayenge, lekin jab wahan pahuche toh haka baka reh gaye.

Ke lehlahata huwa hara bhara bagh mewon se lade hue darakht aur pake hue phal sab gharat aur barbad hochuke hain, sare bagh mein aandhi phir gayi hai aur kul bagh mewon samet jal kar koyla hogaya hai, koi phal nisf dam ka bhi nahi raha, sari tarotazagi پژمردگی (pazmurdagi) se badal gayi hai, bagh sara ka sara jal kar rakh hogaya hai, darakhton ke kale kale daraune tund khade hue hain, pehle to samjhe ke hum rah bhool gaye kisi aur bagh mein chale aaye aur yeh matlab bhi hosakta hai ke hamara tareeqa-e-kar ghalat tha jiska yeh nateeja hai, phir baghaur dekhne se jab yaqeen hogaya ke bagh to yeh hamara hi hai tab samajh gaye aur kehne lage hai to yehi lekin hum badqismat hain, hamare naseeb mein hi iska phal aur faida nahi, in sab mein jo adl-o-insaf wala aur bhalai aur behtari wala tha woh bol pada ke dekho main to pehle hi tumse kehta tha ke tum Insha'Allah kyun nahi kehte, Sadi farmate hain unke zamanah mein SubhanAllah kehna bhi Insha'Allah kehne ke qaim maqam tha, Imam Ibn Jareer farmate hain iske maani hi Insha'Allah kehne ke hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke unke behtar shakhs ne unse kaha ke dekho maine to tumhe pehle hi keh diya tha ke tum kyun Allah ki pakeezgi aur uski hamd-o-sana nahi karte? Yeh sun kar ab woh kehne lage hamara Rab pak hai beshak hum ne apni janon par zulm kiya, ab itaat baja laye jabke azab pahunch chuka, ab apni taqseer ko mana jab saza de di gayi, ab to ek dusre ko malamat karne lage ke hum ne bahut hi bura kiya ke maskinon ka haq marna chaha aur Allah ki farmanbardari se ruk gaye, phir sab ne kaha ke koi shak nahi hamari sarkashi had se badh gayi isi wajah se Allah ka azab aaya, phir kehte hain shayad hamara Rab humein isse behtar badla de yani duniya mein aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke akhirat ke khayal se unhone yeh kaha ho, Wallahu A'lam, baaz salaf ka qaul hai ke yeh waqia Ahl-e-Yaman ka hai, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain yeh log Frawan ke rehne wale the jo Sana se chhe mil ke fasla par ek basti hai aur mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh Ahl-e-Habsha thay.

Yahan un kafiron ki jo Huzoor ﷺ ki nubuwwat ko jhutla rahe the misal bayaan ho rahi hai ke jis tarah yeh bagh wale the ke Allah ki naemat ki nashukri ki aur Allah ke azabon mein apne aap ko daal diya, yehi halat in kafiron ki hai ke Allah ki naemat yaani Huzoor ﷺ ki paigambar ki nashukri yaani inkar ne inhein bhi Allah ki narazgi ka mustahiq kar diya hai, to farmata hai ke hum ne inhein bhi azma liya jis tarah hum ne bagh walon ko azmaya tha jis bagh mein tarah tarah ke phal mewe wagaira the, un logon ne aapas mein qasmein khayein ke subah se pehle hi pehle raat ke waqt phal utaar lenge taaki faqiron miskinon aur saailon ko pata na chale jo woh aa khade hon aur hamein un ko bhi dena pade balke kal phal aur mewe khud hi le aayenge, apni is tadbeer ki kamyabi par inhein ghuroor tha aur is khushi mein phule hue the yahan tak ke Allah ko bhi bhool gaye Insha'Allah tak kisi ki zubaan se na nikla is liye inhein yeh qasam poori na hui, raat hi raat mein un ke pahunchne se pehle aasmani aafat ne sare bagh ko jala kar khakistar kar diya aisa ho gaya jaise siyah raat aur kati hui kheti, ishi liye Huzoor ﷺ irshad farmate hain ke logo gunahon se bacho gunahon ki shamat ki wajah se insaan us rozi se bhi mahroom kar diya jata hai jo us ke liye tayyar kar di gayi hai phir Huzoor ﷺ ne in do aayaton ki tilawat ki ke yeh log ba-sabab apne gunah ke apne bagh ke phal aur us ki paidawar se be-naseeb ho gaye (Ibn Abi Hatim). Subah ke waqt yeh aapas mein ek dusre ko aawazein dene lage ke agar phal utaarne ka irada hai toh ab der na lagao sawere hi chal pado, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh bagh angoor ka tha, ab yeh chupke chupke baatein karte hue chale taaki koi sun na le aur ghareeb ghurba ko pata na lag jaye, chunke inhein ki sargoshiyan us Allah se toh posheeda nahi reh sakti thin jo dili iradon se bhi poori tarah waqif rehta hai woh bayaan farmata hai ke un ki woh khufiya baatein yeh thin ke dekho hoshyar raho koi miskin bhank paakar kahin aaj aa na jaye hargiz kisi faqir ko bagh mein ghusne hi na dena ab quwat aur shiddat ke sath pukhta irade aur ghareebon par ghusse ke sath apne bagh ko chale, Sadi farmate hain Hard un ki basti ka naam tha lekin yeh kuch zyada theek nahi maloom hota. Yeh jaante the ke ab hum phalon par qabiz hain abhi utaar kar sab le aayenge, lekin jab wahan pahuche toh haka baka reh gaye.

Ke lehlahata huwa hara bhara bagh mewon se lade hue darakht aur pake hue phal sab gharat aur barbad hochuke hain, sare bagh mein aandhi phir gayi hai aur kul bagh mewon samet jal kar koyla hogaya hai, koi phal nisf dam ka bhi nahi raha, sari tarotazagi پژمردگی (pazmurdagi) se badal gayi hai, bagh sara ka sara jal kar rakh hogaya hai, darakhton ke kale kale daraune tund khade hue hain, pehle to samjhe ke hum rah bhool gaye kisi aur bagh mein chale aaye aur yeh matlab bhi hosakta hai ke hamara tareeqa-e-kar ghalat tha jiska yeh nateeja hai, phir baghaur dekhne se jab yaqeen hogaya ke bagh to yeh hamara hi hai tab samajh gaye aur kehne lage hai to yehi lekin hum badqismat hain, hamare naseeb mein hi iska phal aur faida nahi, in sab mein jo adl-o-insaf wala aur bhalai aur behtari wala tha woh bol pada ke dekho main to pehle hi tumse kehta tha ke tum Insha'Allah kyun nahi kehte, Sadi farmate hain unke zamanah mein SubhanAllah kehna bhi Insha'Allah kehne ke qaim maqam tha, Imam Ibn Jareer farmate hain iske maani hi Insha'Allah kehne ke hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke unke behtar shakhs ne unse kaha ke dekho maine to tumhe pehle hi keh diya tha ke tum kyun Allah ki pakeezgi aur uski hamd-o-sana nahi karte? Yeh sun kar ab woh kehne lage hamara Rab pak hai beshak hum ne apni janon par zulm kiya, ab itaat baja laye jabke azab pahunch chuka, ab apni taqseer ko mana jab saza de di gayi, ab to ek dusre ko malamat karne lage ke hum ne bahut hi bura kiya ke maskinon ka haq marna chaha aur Allah ki farmanbardari se ruk gaye, phir sab ne kaha ke koi shak nahi hamari sarkashi had se badh gayi isi wajah se Allah ka azab aaya, phir kehte hain shayad hamara Rab humein isse behtar badla de yani duniya mein aur yeh bhi mumkin hai ke akhirat ke khayal se unhone yeh kaha ho, Wallahu A'lam, baaz salaf ka qaul hai ke yeh waqia Ahl-e-Yaman ka hai, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain yeh log Frawan ke rehne wale the jo Sana se chhe mil ke fasla par ek basti hai aur mufassireen kehte hain ke yeh Ahl-e-Habsha thay.

Mazhaban Ahl-e-Kitab thay, yeh bagh unhein un ke baap ke warse mein mila tha. Is ka yeh dastoor tha ke bagh ki paidawar mein se bagh ka kharch nikaal kar apne aur apne baal bachon ke liye saal bhar ka kharch rakh kar baaqi nafa Allah ke naam sadqa kar deta tha. Us ke inteqaal ke baad un bachon ne aapas mein mashwra kiya aur kaha ke hamara baap to bewuqoof tha jo itni badi rakam har saal idhar udhar de deta tha, hum in faqiron ko agar na dein aur apna maal baqaida sanbhaal_ein to bohat jald daulatmand ban jayenge. Yeh irada unhon ne pukhta kar liya to un par woh azab aaya jis ne asl maal bhi tabaah kar diya aur bilkul khaali haath reh gaye. Phir farmata hai jo shakhs bhi Allah ke hukmon ke khilaf kare aur Allah ki nematon mein bakhal kare aur maskinon mohtajon ka haq ada na kare aur Allah ki nemat ki nashukri kare, us par usi tarah ke azab nazil hote hain aur yeh to duniyawi azab hain, aakhirat ke azab to abhi baaqi hain jo sakht tar aur badtar hain. Baihaqi ki ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne raat ke waqt kheti kaatne aur bagh ke phal utaarne se mana farma diya hai.

Gunahgar aur neko kar dono ki jaza ka mukhtalif hona lazim hai. Upar chunke duniyavi jannat walon ka haal bayan hua tha aur Allah ki na-safarmani aur uske hukm ke khilaf karne se un par jo bala aur aafat aayi thi uska ذکر hua tha, isliye ab un muttaqi parhezgar logon ka haal zikr kiya gaya jinhein aakhirat mein jannatein milengi, jin ki neamatein na fana hon, na ghaten, na khatam hon, na sadein, na galein. Phir farmata hai: Kya ho sakta hai ki musalman aur gunahgar jaza mein yaksan ho jayen? Qasam hai zameen-o-aasman ke Rab ki ki yeh nahi ho sakta. Kya ho gaya hai tum kis tarah yeh chahte ho? Kya tumhare hathon mein Allah ki taraf se utri hui koi aisi kitab hai jo khud tumhein bhi mehfooz ho aur guzishta logon ke hathon tum pichhlon tak pahunchti ho aur usmein wahi ho jo tumhari chahat hai aur tum keh rahe ho ki hamara koi mazboot wada aur ahd tum se hai ki tum jo keh rahe ho wahi hoga aur tumhari be-ja aur ghalat khwahishein poori ho kar hi rahengi? Un se zara poochho to ki is baat ka kaun zamin hai aur kis ke zimme yeh kafalat hai? Na sahi tumhare jo jhoote mabood hain unhi ko apni sachai ke suboot mein pesh karo.

Sajda us waqt munafiqon ke bas mein nahi hoga. Upar chunke bayan hua tha ke parhezgar logon ke liye neamton wali jannatein hain isliye yahan bayan ho raha hai ke yeh jannatein unhe kab milengi? To farmaya ke us din jis din pandli khol di jayegi. Yaani Qiyamat ke din jo din bari haulnakiyon wala, zalzalon wala, imtihan wala aur aazmaish wala aur bare bare aham umoor ke zahir hone ka din hoga. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is jagah Hadrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ki yeh hadith hai ke maine Rasoolullah ﷺ se suna farmate the hamara Rab apni pandli khol dega pas har momin mard aur har momina aurat sajde mein girparegi, haan duniya mein jo log dikhawe sunaawe ke liye sajda karte the woh bhi sajda karna chahenge lekin unki kamar takhta ki taraf hojaye gi, yaani unse sajde ke liye jhuka na jayega, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim dono mein hai aur dusri kitabon mein bhi hai kayi kayi sanadon se alfaaz ke her pher ke sath marwi hai aur yeh hadith mutawwal hai aur mashhoor hai. 

Hadrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain yeh din takleef, dukh, dard aur shiddat ka din hai (Ibn Jareer). Aur Ibn Jareer ise dusri sanad se shak ke sath bayan karte hain woh Ibn Masood ya Ibn Abbas se ayat (Yauuma yukshafu ‘an saaqin wa yud’auna ilas-sujuudi fala yastati’oon) (Surah (Al-Qalam: 42) ki tafseer mein bahut bara azeem-ush-shan amr marwi hai jaise shayar ka qaul hai (Shalat-ul-harbu ‘an saaq). Yahan bhi larai ki azmat aur barai bayan ki gayi hai. Mujahid se bhi yahi marwi hai. 

Hadrat Abdullah bin Abbas farmate hain Qiyamat ke din ki yeh ghari bahut sakht hogi, aap farmate hain yeh amr bahut sakht, bari ghabrahat wala aur haulnak hai, aap farmate hain jis waqt amr khol diya jayega aamal zahir hojayenge aur yeh khulna akhirat ka aa jata hai aur isse kaam ka khul jana hai. Yeh sab riwayatein Ibn Jareer mein hain. Iske baad yeh hadith Abu Yala mein bhi hai aur iski asnad mein ek mubham rawi hai wallahu aalam. 

( Yaad rahe ke sahih tafseer wahi hai jo Bukhari Muslim ke hawale se upar marfoo hadith mein guzri ke Allah Azzawajal apni pandli kholega, dusri hadith bhi matlab ke lihaz se theek hai kyunke Allah khud noor aur aqwal bhi is tarah theek hain ke Allah aalam ki pandli bhi zahir hogi aur sath hi woh haulnakiyan aur shiddatein bhi hongi wallahu aalam. (Mutarjim) 

Phir farmate hain jis din un logon ki aankhein upar ko na uthengi aur zaleel o past hojayenge kyunke duniya mein bare sarkash aur kibr o guroor wale the. Sehat aur salamati ki halat mein duniya mein jab unhe sajde ke liye bulaya jata tha toh ruk jate the jiski saza yeh mili ke aaj sajda karna chahte hain lekin nahi kar sakte, pehle kar sakte the lekin nahi karte the. Allah Ta'ala ki tajalli dekh kar momin sab sajde mein girparenge lekin kafir o munafiq sajda na kar sakenge, kamar takhta hojaye gi jhukegi hi nahi balki peeth ke bal chat girparenge. Yahan bhi unki halat mominon ke khilaf thi wahan bhi khilaf hi rahenge.

Phir farmaya mujhe aur meri is hadith yaani Quran ko jhutlane walon ko tu chhod de, is mein badi waeed hai aur sakht dant hai ke tu thehar ja main aap un se nipat loonga dekh to sahi ke kis tarah badar-tarij unhein pakadta hoon yeh apni sarkashi aur ghuroor mein padte jayenge meri dheel ke raaz ko na samjhenge aur phir ek dam yeh paap ka ghada phootega aur main achanak unhein pakad loonga. Main unhein badhata rahoonga yeh bad-mast hote chale jayenge woh ise karamat samjhenge halanki woh ihanat hogi, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wa baneen 55) (Al-Mu'minun: 55), yaani kya un ka guman hai ke maal-o-aulad ka badhna un ke liye hamari janib se kisi bhalai ki bina par hai, nahi balki yeh be-shaoor hain aur jagah farmaya ayat (Falamma naso ma zukkiru bihi fatahna ‘alaihim abwaba kulli shayin hatta idha farihoo bima ooto akhaznahum baghtatan fa-idha hum mublison 44) (Al-An'am: 44) jab yeh hamare waiz-o-pand ko bhula chuke to hum ne un par tamam cheezon ke darwaze khol diye yahan tak ke unhein jo diya gaya tha us par utrane lage to hum ne unhein nagahani pakad liya aur un ki umidein munqati ho gayin. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai main unhein dheel doonga, badhaunga aur ooncha karunga yeh mera dao hai aur meri tadbeer mere mukhalifon aur mere nafarmanon ke sath bahut badi hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala zalim ko mohlat deta hai phir jab pakadta hai to chhodta nahi phir aap ne yeh ayat padhi (Wa kathalika akhzu rabbika idha akhzal-qura wa hiya zalimatun inna akhzahu aleemun shadeed) (Hud: 102) yaani isi tarah hai tere Rab ki pakad jabke woh kisi basti walon ko pakadta hai jo zalim hote hain us ki pakad badi dard-nak aur bahut sakht hai. Phir farmaya tu kuch un se ujrat aur badla to mangta hi nahi jo un par bhari padta ho jis tawan se yeh jhuke jate hon, na un ke paas koi ilm-e-ghaib hai jise yeh likh rahe hon. In dono jumlon ki tafseer Surah At-Tur mein guzar chuki hai khulasa-e-matlab yeh hai ke Aye Nabi ﷺ aap unhein Allah Azzawajal ki taraf baghair ujrat aur baghair maal talbi ke aur baghair badle ki chahat ke bula rahe hain aap ki gharz siwai sawab hasil karne ke aur koi nahi is par bhi yeh log sirf apni jahalat aur kufr aur sarkashi ki wajah se aap ko jhutla rahe hain.))

In dono jumlon ki tafseer Surah At-Tur mein guzar chuki hai khulasa-e-matlab yeh hai ke Aye Nabi ﷺ aap unhein Allah Azzawajal ki taraf baghair ujrat aur baghair maal talbi ke aur baghair badle ki chahat ke bula rahe hain aap ki gharz siwai sawab hasil karne ke aur koi nahi is par bhi yeh log sirf apni jahalat aur kufr aur sarkashi ki wajah se aap ko jhutla rahe hain.))

Sajda us waqt munafiqon ke bas mein nahi hoga. Upar chunke bayan hua tha ke parhezgar logon ke liye neamton wali jannatein hain isliye yahan bayan ho raha hai ke yeh jannatein unhe kab milengi? To farmaya ke us din jis din pandli khol di jayegi. Yaani Qiyamat ke din jo din bari haulnakiyon wala, zalzalon wala, imtihan wala aur aazmaish wala aur bare bare aham umoor ke zahir hone ka din hoga. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is jagah Hadrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ki yeh hadith hai ke maine Rasoolullah ﷺ se suna farmate the hamara Rab apni pandli khol dega pas har momin mard aur har momina aurat sajde mein girparegi, haan duniya mein jo log dikhawe sunaawe ke liye sajda karte the woh bhi sajda karna chahenge lekin unki kamar takhta ki taraf hojaye gi, yaani unse sajde ke liye jhuka na jayega, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim dono mein hai aur dusri kitabon mein bhi hai kayi kayi sanadon se alfaaz ke her pher ke sath marwi hai aur yeh hadith mutawwal hai aur mashhoor hai. 

Hadrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain yeh din takleef, dukh, dard aur shiddat ka din hai (Ibn Jareer). Aur Ibn Jareer ise dusri sanad se shak ke sath bayan karte hain woh Ibn Masood ya Ibn Abbas se ayat (Yauuma yukshafu ‘an saaqin wa yud’auna ilas-sujuudi fala yastati’oon) (Surah (Al-Qalam: 42) ki tafseer mein bahut bara azeem-ush-shan amr marwi hai jaise shayar ka qaul hai (Shalat-ul-harbu ‘an saaq). Yahan bhi larai ki azmat aur barai bayan ki gayi hai. Mujahid se bhi yahi marwi hai. 

Hadrat Abdullah bin Abbas farmate hain Qiyamat ke din ki yeh ghari bahut sakht hogi, aap farmate hain yeh amr bahut sakht, bari ghabrahat wala aur haulnak hai, aap farmate hain jis waqt amr khol diya jayega aamal zahir hojayenge aur yeh khulna akhirat ka aa jata hai aur isse kaam ka khul jana hai. Yeh sab riwayatein Ibn Jareer mein hain. Iske baad yeh hadith Abu Yala mein bhi hai aur iski asnad mein ek mubham rawi hai wallahu aalam. 

( Yaad rahe ke sahih tafseer wahi hai jo Bukhari Muslim ke hawale se upar marfoo hadith mein guzri ke Allah Azzawajal apni pandli kholega, dusri hadith bhi matlab ke lihaz se theek hai kyunke Allah khud noor aur aqwal bhi is tarah theek hain ke Allah aalam ki pandli bhi zahir hogi aur sath hi woh haulnakiyan aur shiddatein bhi hongi wallahu aalam. (Mutarjim) 

Phir farmate hain jis din un logon ki aankhein upar ko na uthengi aur zaleel o past hojayenge kyunke duniya mein bare sarkash aur kibr o guroor wale the. Sehat aur salamati ki halat mein duniya mein jab unhe sajde ke liye bulaya jata tha toh ruk jate the jiski saza yeh mili ke aaj sajda karna chahte hain lekin nahi kar sakte, pehle kar sakte the lekin nahi karte the. Allah Ta'ala ki tajalli dekh kar momin sab sajde mein girparenge lekin kafir o munafiq sajda na kar sakenge, kamar takhta hojaye gi jhukegi hi nahi balki peeth ke bal chat girparenge. Yahan bhi unki halat mominon ke khilaf thi wahan bhi khilaf hi rahenge.

Phir farmaya mujhe aur meri is hadith yaani Quran ko jhutlane walon ko tu chhod de, is mein badi waeed hai aur sakht dant hai ke tu thehar ja main aap un se nipat loonga dekh to sahi ke kis tarah badar-tarij unhein pakadta hoon yeh apni sarkashi aur ghuroor mein padte jayenge meri dheel ke raaz ko na samjhenge aur phir ek dam yeh paap ka ghada phootega aur main achanak unhein pakad loonga. Main unhein badhata rahoonga yeh bad-mast hote chale jayenge woh ise karamat samjhenge halanki woh ihanat hogi, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wa baneen 55) (Al-Mu'minun: 55), yaani kya un ka guman hai ke maal-o-aulad ka badhna un ke liye hamari janib se kisi bhalai ki bina par hai, nahi balki yeh be-shaoor hain aur jagah farmaya ayat (Falamma naso ma zukkiru bihi fatahna ‘alaihim abwaba kulli shayin hatta idha farihoo bima ooto akhaznahum baghtatan fa-idha hum mublison 44) (Al-An'am: 44) jab yeh hamare waiz-o-pand ko bhula chuke to hum ne un par tamam cheezon ke darwaze khol diye yahan tak ke unhein jo diya gaya tha us par utrane lage to hum ne unhein nagahani pakad liya aur un ki umidein munqati ho gayin. Yahan bhi irshad hota hai main unhein dheel doonga, badhaunga aur ooncha karunga yeh mera dao hai aur meri tadbeer mere mukhalifon aur mere nafarmanon ke sath bahut badi hai. In dono jumlon ki tafseer Surah At-Tur mein guzar chuki hai khulasa-e-matlab yeh hai ke Aye Nabi ﷺ aap unhein Allah Azzawajal ki taraf baghair ujrat aur baghair maal talbi ke aur baghair badle ki chahat ke bula rahe hain aap ki gharz siwai sawab hasil karne ke aur koi nahi is par bhi yeh log sirf apni jahalat aur kufr aur sarkashi ki wajah se aap ko jhutla rahe hain.))

Masaib se nijat dilane wali dua, nazar, faal aur shagoon 

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ki ae Nabi (ﷺ) apni kaum ki izaa par aur unke jhutlane par sabr-o-zabt karo, anqareeb Allah Ta'ala ka faisla hone wala hai, anjam-e-kaar aap ka aur aapke matohton ka hi ghalba hoga duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi. Dekho tum machhli wale Nabi ki tarah na hona, isse murad Hazrat Yunus bin Matta (A.S) hain jabki woh apni kaum par ghazabnak ho kar nikal khade hue, phir jo hua so hua, yaani aap ka jahaz mein sawaar hona, machhli ka aap ko nigal jana aur samandar ki teh mein baith jana aur un teh ba-teh andheron mein is qadr neeche aap ka samandar ko Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi bayan karte hue sunna aur khud aap ka bhi pukarna aur aayat (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin) (Al-Anbiya: 87) parhna, phir aap ki dua ka qabool hona, us gham se nijat pana waghaira jis waqia ka mufassal bayan pehle guzar chuka hai. Jiske bayan ke baad Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ka irshad hai ki hum isi tarah imandaron ko nijat diya karte hain aur farmata hai ki agar woh tasbeeh na karte toh qiyamat tak usi ke pait mein pade rehte. 

Yahan bhi farman hai ki jab us ne gham aur dukh ki halat mein humein pukara, pehle bayan ho chuka hai ki Yunus (A.S) ki zuban se nikalte hi yeh kalma arsh par pohncha, farishton ne kaha ya Rabb is kamzor ghair maroof shakhs ki aawaz toh aisi maloom hoti hai jaise pehle ki suni hui ho. Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne farmaya kya tum ne ise pehchana nahi? Farishton ne arz kiya nahi, Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya yeh mere bande Yunus ki aawaz hai. Farishton ne kaha parvardigar phir toh tera yeh banda woh hai jiske aamal-e-saleha roz aasmanon par chadhte rahe, jiski duayein har waqt qabooliyat ka darja pati rahein, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya sach hai. Farishton ne kaha phir ae Arham-ur-Rahimeen! Unke aasaniyon ke waqt ke nek aamal ki bina par unhein is sakhti se nijat ata farma. Chunache farman-e-bari hua ki ae machhli tu unhein ugal de aur machhli ne unhein kinare par aa kar ugal diya. 

Yahan bhi yahi bayan ho raha hai ki Allah ne ise phir bargasheeda bana liya aur nek kaaron mein kar diya. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasulullah (ﷺ) farmate hain kisi ko laiq nahi ki woh apne aap ko Hazrat Yunus bin Matta se afzal bataye.

Bukhari o Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith hai, agli ayat ka matlab yeh hai ki tere bughz-o-hasad ki wajah se yeh kuffar toh apni ankhon se ghor ghor kar tujhe phisla dena chahte hain agar Allah ki taraf se himayat aur bachao na hota toh yaqinan yeh aisa kar guzarte, is ayat mein dalil hai is amr par ki nazar ka lagna aur us ki tasir ka Allah ke hukm se hona haq hai jaisa ki bahut si ahadith mein bhi hai jo kayi kayi sanado se marvi hai, Abu Dawud mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain dam jhada sirf nazar ka aur zehrele janwaron ka aur na thamne wale khoon ka hai, baaz sanado mein nazar ka lafz nahi yeh hadith Ibn Majah mein bhi hai aur Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi ek qissa ke sath mauqufan marvi hai, Bukhari Sharif aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, ek gharib hadith Abu Yala mein hai ki nazar mein kuch bhi haq nahi sab se sacha shagoon faal hai, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise gharib kehte hain aur riwayat mein hai ki koi dar, khauf, ullu aur nazar nahi aur naik fali sab se zyada sacha faal hai aur riwayaton mein hai ki nazar haq hai, nazar haq hai, woh bulandi wale ko bhi utar deti hai (Musnad Ahmad) Sahih Muslim mein hai nazar haq hai agar koi cheez taqdeer se sabqat karne wali hoti toh nazar kar jati jab tum se ghusal karaya jaye toh ghusal kar liya karo, Abdur Razzaq mein hai ki An-Hazrat ﷺ Hadhrat Hasan aur Hadhrat Hussain in alfaaz ke sath panah mein dete dua (A'izukuma bi-kalimat-illah-it-tammati min kulli shaitanin wa hammatin wa min kulli 'aynin lammatin) yaani tum dono ko Allah Ta'ala ke bharpoor kalmat ki panah mein saunpta hoon har shaitan se aur har ek zehrele janwar se aur har ek lag jane wali nazar se aur farmate ki Hadhrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) bhi Hadhrat Ishaq aur Hadhrat Ismail (Alaihimas Salam) ko inhi alfaaz se Allah ki panah diya karte the, yeh hadith Sunan mein aur Bukhari Sharif mein bhi hai, Ibn Majah mein hai ki Sahl bin Hunaif ghusal kar rahe the Amir bin Rabi'ah kehne lage maine toh aaj tak aisa badan kisi parda-nasheen ka bhi nahi dekha bas zara si der mein woh behosh ho kar gir pade logon ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ in ki khabar lijiye yeh toh behosh ho gaye Aap ne farmaya kisi par tumhara shak bhi hai logon ne kaha kahan Amir bin Rabi'ah par, Aap ne farmaya tum mein se kyun koi apne bhai ko qatal karta hai jab tum mein se koi apne bhai ki kisi aisi cheez ko dekhe ki use bahut achhi lage toh use chahiye ki us ke liye barkat ki dua kare phir pani mangwa kar Amir se farmaya tum wuzu karo munh aur kohniyon tak hath aur ghutne aur tahband ke andar ka hissa jism dho dalo.

Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya bartan ko us ki peeth ke peechhe se oundha do, Nasai waghera mein bhi yeh riwayat maujood hai, Hazrat Abu Saeed farmate hain Anhadrat ﷺ jinnaat ki aur insano ki nazar-e-bad se panaah maanga karte the, jab Surah Mu'awwizat nazil huin to Aap ne unhein le liya aur sab ko chhod diya (Ibn Majah, Tirmidhi, Nasai). Musnad waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Jibrail A.S Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kaha Aai Nabi-e-Sahib ﷺ kya aap beemar hain? Aap ne farmaya haan, to Jibrail A.S ne kaha dua: (Bismillah arqika min kulli shayin yu'duzika min sharri kulli nafsin wa 'aynin, wallahu yushfiqa, Bismillah arqika). Baaz riwayato mein kuch alfaaz ka her pher bhi hai, Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke yaqinan nazar ka lag jana bar-haq hai, Musnad ki ek hadith mein is ke baad yun bhi hai ke is ka sabab Shaitan hai aur Ibn-e-Adam ka hasad hai. Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se pucha jata hai ke kya tum ne Huzoor ﷺ se suna hai ke shagoon teen cheezon mein hai ghar, ghoda aur aurat? To Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ne farmaya phir to main Rasoolullah ﷺ par woh kahunga jo Aap ne nahi farmaya, haan main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yeh to suna hai ke Aap ne farmaya sab se sacha shagoon naik faali hai aur nazar ka lagna haq hai. Tirmidhi waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Asma R.A ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ Hazrat Jafar ke bachoon ko nazar lag jaya karti hai to kya main kuch dam kara liya karoon? Aap ne farmaya haan, agar koi cheez taqdeer se sabqat kar jaane wali hoti to woh nazar thi. Hazrat Aisha R.A ko bhi Huzoor ﷺ ka nazar-e-bad se dam karne ka hukm marwi hai (Ibn Majah). Hazrat Aisha R.A farmati hain ke nazar lagane wale ko hukm kiya jata tha ke woh wuzu kare aur jis ko nazar lagi hai use is pani se ghusal karaya jata tha (Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai, nahi hai ullu aur nazar haq hai aur sab se sacha shagoon faal hai. Musnad Ahmad mein bhi Hazrat Sahl aur Hazrat Aamir wala qissa jo upar bayan hua qadray tafseel ke sath marwi hai, baaz riwayato mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh dono buzurg ghusal ke irade se chale aur Hazrat Aamir pani mein ghusal ke liye utre aur un ka badan dekh kar Hazrat Sahl ki nazar lag gayi aur woh wahin pani mein kharkharahat karne lage, main ne teen martaba aawazein di lekin jawab na mila, main Anhadrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur waqia sunaya, Aap khud tashreef laye aur thode se pani mein khach khach karte hue tehband uncha uthaye hue wahan tak pounche aur un ke seene mein hath mara aur dua ki: (Allahumma asrif 'anhu harraha wa bardaha wa wasabaha) Aai Allah tu is se is ki garmi aur sardi aur takleef door kar de.

Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai ke meri ummat ki qaza-o-qadar ke baad aksar maut nazar se hogi, farmate hain nazar haq hai insan ko qabr tak pohncha deti hai aur oont ko handiya tak, meri ummat ki aksar halaki isi mein hai. Ek aur sahih sanad se bhi yeh riwayat marwi hai, farman-e-risalat hai ke ek ki beemari doosre ko nahi lagti aur na ullu ki wajah se barbadi ka yaqeen kar lena koi waqiyat rakhta hai aur na hasad koi cheez hai, haan nazar sach hai. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Jibrail huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aap us waqt ghamzada the, jab poochha to farmaya Hasan aur Husain ko nazar lag gayi hai, farmaya yeh sachai ke qabil cheez hai nazar waqayi lagti hai, aap ne yeh kalmaat parh kar unhein panah mein kyun na diya? Huzoor ﷺ ne poochha woh kalmaat kya hain? Farmaya yun kaho: Allahumma Dhal-Sultan-il-Azim, Dhal-Munn-il-Qadim, Dhal-Wajh-il-Karim, Wali-al-Kalimat-it-Tammati wa-al-Da'wat-il-Mustajabat, 'Afi Hasan-wa-Husain min anfus-il-jinni wa a'yun-il-insi. Yaani Aie Allah! Aie bohat bari badshahi wale, aie zabardast qadeem ehsano wale, aie buzurg-tar chehre wale, aie poore kalmon wale aur aie duaoon ko qubooliyat ka darja dene wale, tu Hasan aur Husain ko tamam jinnaat ki hawaon se aur tamam insan ki ankhon se apni panah de. Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh dua parhi wahin dono bachche uth khare hue aur aap ke samne khelne koodne lage, to huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Logon! Apni janon ko, apni biwiyon ko aur apni aulad ko isi panah ke sath panah diya karo, is jaisi aur koi panah ki dua nahi. Phir farmata hai ke jahan yeh kafir apni haqarat bhari nazrein aap par dalte hain wahan apni tana-amez zaban bhi aap par kholte hain aur kehte hain ke yeh to Quran lane mein majnoon hain, Allah Ta'ala unke jawab mein farmata hai Quran to Allah ki taraf se tamam aalam ke liye naseehat-nama hai. Alhamdulillah Surah Noon ki tafseer khatam hui.

To Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ne farmaya phir to main Rasoolullah ﷺ par woh kahunga jo Aap ne nahi farmaya, haan main ne Huzoor ﷺ se yeh to suna hai ke Aap ne farmaya sab se sacha shagoon naik faali hai aur nazar ka lagna haq hai. Tirmidhi waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Asma R.A ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ Hazrat Jafar ke bachoon ko nazar lag jaya karti hai to kya main kuch dam kara liya karoon? Aap ne farmaya haan, agar koi cheez taqdeer se sabqat kar jaane wali hoti to woh nazar thi. Hazrat Aisha R.A ko bhi Huzoor ﷺ ka nazar-e-bad se dam karne ka hukm marwi hai (Ibn Majah). Hazrat Aisha R.A farmati hain ke nazar lagane wale ko hukm kiya jata tha ke woh wuzu kare aur jis ko nazar lagi hai use is pani se ghusal karaya jata tha (Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai, nahi hai ullu aur nazar haq hai aur sab se sacha shagoon faal hai. Musnad Ahmad mein bhi Hazrat Sahl aur Hazrat Aamir wala qissa jo upar bayan hua qadray tafseel ke sath marwi hai, baaz riwayato mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh dono buzurg ghusal ke irade se chale aur Hazrat Aamir pani mein ghusal ke liye utre aur un ka badan dekh kar Hazrat Sahl ki nazar lag gayi aur woh wahin pani mein kharkharahat karne lage, main ne teen martaba aawazein di lekin jawab na mila, main Anhadrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur waqia sunaya, Aap khud tashreef laye aur thode se pani mein khach khach karte hue tehband uncha uthaye hue wahan tak pounche aur un ke seene mein hath mara aur dua ki: (Allahumma asrif 'anhu harraha wa bardaha wa wasabaha) Aai Allah tu is se is ki garmi aur sardi aur takleef door kar de.

Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai ke meri ummat ki qaza-o-qadar ke baad aksar maut nazar se hogi, farmate hain nazar haq hai insan ko qabr tak pohncha deti hai aur oont ko handiya tak, meri ummat ki aksar halaki isi mein hai. Ek aur sahih sanad se bhi yeh riwayat marwi hai, farman-e-risalat hai ke ek ki beemari doosre ko nahi lagti aur na ullu ki wajah se barbadi ka yaqeen kar lena koi waqiyat rakhta hai aur na hasad koi cheez hai, haan nazar sach hai. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Jibrail huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aap us waqt ghamzada the, jab poochha to farmaya Hasan aur Husain ko nazar lag gayi hai, farmaya yeh sachai ke qabil cheez hai nazar waqayi lagti hai, aap ne yeh kalmaat parh kar unhein panah mein kyun na diya? Huzoor ﷺ ne poochha woh kalmaat kya hain? Farmaya yun kaho: Allahumma Dhal-Sultan-il-Azim, Dhal-Munn-il-Qadim, Dhal-Wajh-il-Karim, Wali-al-Kalimat-it-Tammati wa-al-Da'wat-il-Mustajabat, 'Afi Hasan-wa-Husain min anfus-il-jinni wa a'yun-il-insi. Yaani Aie Allah! Aie bohat bari badshahi wale, aie zabardast qadeem ehsano wale, aie buzurg-tar chehre wale, aie poore kalmon wale aur aie duaoon ko qubooliyat ka darja dene wale, tu Hasan aur Husain ko tamam jinnaat ki hawaon se aur tamam insan ki ankhon se apni panah de. Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh dua parhi wahin dono bachche uth khare hue aur aap ke samne khelne koodne lage, to huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Logon! Apni janon ko, apni biwiyon ko aur apni aulad ko isi panah ke sath panah diya karo, is jaisi aur koi panah ki dua nahi. Phir farmata hai ke jahan yeh kafir apni haqarat bhari nazrein aap par dalte hain wahan apni tana-amez zaban bhi aap par kholte hain aur kehte hain ke yeh to Quran lane mein majnoon hain, Allah Ta'ala unke jawab mein farmata hai Quran to Allah ki taraf se tamam aalam ke liye naseehat-nama hai. Alhamdulillah Surah Noon ki tafseer khatam hui.

Masaib se nijat dilane wali dua, nazar, faal aur shagoon 

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ki ae Nabi (ﷺ) apni kaum ki izaa par aur unke jhutlane par sabr-o-zabt karo, anqareeb Allah Ta'ala ka faisla hone wala hai, anjam-e-kaar aap ka aur aapke matohton ka hi ghalba hoga duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi. Dekho tum machhli wale Nabi ki tarah na hona, isse murad Hazrat Yunus bin Matta (A.S) hain jabki woh apni kaum par ghazabnak ho kar nikal khade hue, phir jo hua so hua, yaani aap ka jahaz mein sawaar hona, machhli ka aap ko nigal jana aur samandar ki teh mein baith jana aur un teh ba-teh andheron mein is qadr neeche aap ka samandar ko Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi bayan karte hue sunna aur khud aap ka bhi pukarna aur aayat (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin) (Al-Anbiya: 87) parhna, phir aap ki dua ka qabool hona, us gham se nijat pana waghaira jis waqia ka mufassal bayan pehle guzar chuka hai. Jiske bayan ke baad Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ka irshad hai ki hum isi tarah imandaron ko nijat diya karte hain aur farmata hai ki agar woh tasbeeh na karte toh qiyamat tak usi ke pait mein pade rehte. 

Yahan bhi farman hai ki jab us ne gham aur dukh ki halat mein humein pukara, pehle bayan ho chuka hai ki Yunus (A.S) ki zuban se nikalte hi yeh kalma arsh par pohncha, farishton ne kaha ya Rabb is kamzor ghair maroof shakhs ki aawaz toh aisi maloom hoti hai jaise pehle ki suni hui ho. Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne farmaya kya tum ne ise pehchana nahi? Farishton ne arz kiya nahi, Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya yeh mere bande Yunus ki aawaz hai. Farishton ne kaha parvardigar phir toh tera yeh banda woh hai jiske aamal-e-saleha roz aasmanon par chadhte rahe, jiski duayein har waqt qabooliyat ka darja pati rahein, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya sach hai. Farishton ne kaha phir ae Arham-ur-Rahimeen! Unke aasaniyon ke waqt ke nek aamal ki bina par unhein is sakhti se nijat ata farma. Chunache farman-e-bari hua ki ae machhli tu unhein ugal de aur machhli ne unhein kinare par aa kar ugal diya. 

Yahan bhi yahi bayan ho raha hai ki Allah ne ise phir bargasheeda bana liya aur nek kaaron mein kar diya. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasulullah (ﷺ) farmate hain kisi ko laiq nahi ki woh apne aap ko Hazrat Yunus bin Matta se afzal bataye.

Bukhari o Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith hai, agli ayat ka matlab yeh hai ki tere bughz-o-hasad ki wajah se yeh kuffar toh apni ankhon se ghor ghor kar tujhe phisla dena chahte hain agar Allah ki taraf se himayat aur bachao na hota toh yaqinan yeh aisa kar guzarte, is ayat mein dalil hai is amr par ki nazar ka lagna aur us ki tasir ka Allah ke hukm se hona haq hai jaisa ki bahut si ahadith mein bhi hai jo kayi kayi sanado se marvi hai, Abu Dawud mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain dam jhada sirf nazar ka aur zehrele janwaron ka aur na thamne wale khoon ka hai, baaz sanado mein nazar ka lafz nahi yeh hadith Ibn Majah mein bhi hai aur Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi ek qissa ke sath mauqufan marvi hai, Bukhari Sharif aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, ek gharib hadith Abu Yala mein hai ki nazar mein kuch bhi haq nahi sab se sacha shagoon faal hai, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise gharib kehte hain aur riwayat mein hai ki koi dar, khauf, ullu aur nazar nahi aur naik fali sab se zyada sacha faal hai aur riwayaton mein hai ki nazar haq hai, nazar haq hai, woh bulandi wale ko bhi utar deti hai (Musnad Ahmad) Sahih Muslim mein hai nazar haq hai agar koi cheez taqdeer se sabqat karne wali hoti toh nazar kar jati jab tum se ghusal karaya jaye toh ghusal kar liya karo, Abdur Razzaq mein hai ki An-Hazrat ﷺ Hadhrat Hasan aur Hadhrat Hussain in alfaaz ke sath panah mein dete dua (A'izukuma bi-kalimat-illah-it-tammati min kulli shaitanin wa hammatin wa min kulli 'aynin lammatin) yaani tum dono ko Allah Ta'ala ke bharpoor kalmat ki panah mein saunpta hoon har shaitan se aur har ek zehrele janwar se aur har ek lag jane wali nazar se aur farmate ki Hadhrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) bhi Hadhrat Ishaq aur Hadhrat Ismail (Alaihimas Salam) ko inhi alfaaz se Allah ki panah diya karte the, yeh hadith Sunan mein aur Bukhari Sharif mein bhi hai, Ibn Majah mein hai ki Sahl bin Hunaif ghusal kar rahe the Amir bin Rabi'ah kehne lage maine toh aaj tak aisa badan kisi parda-nasheen ka bhi nahi dekha bas zara si der mein woh behosh ho kar gir pade logon ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ in ki khabar lijiye yeh toh behosh ho gaye Aap ne farmaya kisi par tumhara shak bhi hai logon ne kaha kahan Amir bin Rabi'ah par, Aap ne farmaya tum mein se kyun koi apne bhai ko qatal karta hai jab tum mein se koi apne bhai ki kisi aisi cheez ko dekhe ki use bahut achhi lage toh use chahiye ki us ke liye barkat ki dua kare phir pani mangwa kar Amir se farmaya tum wuzu karo munh aur kohniyon tak hath aur ghutne aur tahband ke andar ka hissa jism dho dalo.

Dusri riwayat mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya bartan ko us ki peeth ke peechhe se oundha do, Nasai waghera mein bhi yeh riwayat maujood hai, Hazrat Abu Saeed farmate hain Anhadrat ﷺ jinnaat ki aur insano ki nazar-e-bad se panaah maanga karte the, jab Surah Mu'awwizat nazil huin to Aap ne unhein le liya aur sab ko chhod diya (Ibn Majah, Tirmidhi, Nasai). Musnad waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Jibrail A.S Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kaha Aai Nabi-e-Sahib ﷺ kya aap beemar hain? Aap ne farmaya haan, to Jibrail A.S ne kaha dua: (Bismillah arqika min kulli shayin yu'duzika min sharri kulli nafsin wa 'aynin, wallahu yushfiqa, Bismillah arqika).
